![9 Tips On How To Prioritize Tasks Effectively At Work](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-e6a5e8f1873a:4)
Task prioritization is `the process of ranking your to-do list by urgency, importance, and impact so you focus on what matters first`.[[1]](https://asana.com/resources/how-prioritize-tasks-work)

### Core Steps to Prioritize

- **Capture:** Write down every task in one place.
- **Evaluate:** Check deadlines, effort, and impact.
- **Schedule:** Put your ranked tasks into a calendar.
- **Review:** Adjust your list as things change.[[1]](https://plane.so/blog/how-to-prioritize-tasks-at-work-effectively-methods-and-process)[[2]](https://asana.com/resources/how-prioritize-tasks-work)

### Popular Methods

- **Eisenhower Matrix:** Sort tasks by urgent versus important.
- **Eat That Frog:** Do your hardest task first.
- **ABCDE Method:** Grade tasks from critical (A) to low priority (E).
- **MoSCoW:** Group into Must, Should, Could, and Won't have.[[1]](https://www.meistertask.com/blog/10-powerful-task-prioritization-methods)[[2]](https://www.zoom.com/en/blog/how-to-prioritize-tasks/)[[3]](https://asana.com/resources/how-prioritize-tasks-work)
